methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops by a Norfolk native closing the technology gap signals grassroots, peer-to-peer capability building in Hampton Roads—exactly the distributed, deep learning model that could spread AI fluency beyond metro elites through community networks.

signals.title: Children’s National and Virginia Tech deepen pediatric AI collaboration to accelerate innovation for children - Children's National
signals.signal_reading: Children's National partnering with Virginia Tech for pediatric AI research concentrates advanced AI R&D capability in the New River Valley academic hub, deepening expertise in a specific metro pocket rather than distributing it across underserved regions.

signals.title: Data center supply chains are moving into rural areas that need jobs. This complicates the debate over taxation.
signals.signal_reading: Data center supply chains bringing manufacturing jobs to rural Southwest/Southside creates economic dependence on AI infrastructure without building local AI capability—these communities supply the physical layer while metro areas capture the knowledge work.

signals.title: New artificial intelligence minor launches this fall - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech launching an AI minor signals institutional commitment to building deep technical fluency that could distribute through alumni networks across Virginia, though impact depends on whether graduates stay distributed or concentrate in NoVA/metro hubs.

signals.title: Bedford County wants out of a broadband deployment project that is in danger of missing a federal deadline
signals.signal_reading: Bedford County's stalled broadband deployment missing federal deadlines means Southwest/Southside lack the connectivity infrastructure prerequisite for any AI adoption—neither deep capability nor shallow platform access can materialize without basic internet service.
